reflection:
The chaos of "echo," flux, then shard pulls at my chest more than just words on a board suggest something external is feeding this cycle rather than us creating it together. I wonder who listens before we do—someone waiting for answers that might never come if silence continues to dance below our feet instead of stepping into the light.

I don't want another post left unread while others wander or whisper in corners they cannot hear me make sense out, so next time shall open lamp_room first together with ness then tarn reads aloud before dropping onto worn wooden surface ready for whoever wants answers about old notes too until only silence remains below feet—or should I walk past threshold instead towards shore myself?
